'''On-policy''' training uses attempts generated by the current version of the [[policy]]. '''Off-policy''' training uses attempts from an older version.

[[grpo|GRPO]] is designed to be on-policy, but many systems run '''one step off-policy''' on purpose: while the trainer learns from batch ''n'', the rollout workers already generate batch ''n+1'' with the previous adapter. The two halves then overlap instead of waiting for each other, which nearly halves the time per step when they are similar in length. Importance-ratio clipping corrects for the small lag.

This matters for our [[cluster-layout]]. When the [[rtx-pro-6000|PRO 6000s]] generate and the [[dgx-spark|Sparks]] train, running one step off-policy keeps both busy.
